Pooling improved the incumbent, but shortening its half-life regressed; reducing its contribution tests whether a slightly stronger immediate recurrent state improves ranking. Exclude padding and future states, retain final-real-position inference, and synchronize predictor metadata. Preserve truncation, embeddings, GRU topology, scoring, loss and optimizer.
